title: Mossy Oak
description: No More Stupid Ugly Birch So Now Try Mossy Oak!
body: This pack replaces ugly birch (Shoutout to Camman18) and replaces it with a bit better looking mossy oak! (I was a bit sloppy but I tried) I always hated the birch texure I'm not sure I like this much better but I felt like doing something new that I hope people like also try to get Camman18 to try this pack please!
